changes: Added explicit bailian provider protocol and metering while retaining legacy GEMINI_* environment names for compatibility. MODEL_FALLBACK_PROVIDER=bailian determines protocol and audit identity.
Bailian enable_thinking follows the primary request; enabled thinking retains requested low reasoning_effort instead of falling back to the provider high default.
Primary cooldown explicitly set to zero: every new turn starts with primary. A successful fallback may complete the same tool turn without repeated switching.
Retains the prior 300-second failed-backup circuit and primary recovery after backup failure.
Primary and backup share the 30-second call deadline, normally reserving up to 20 seconds for primary; tools create further calls within the existing turn rules.
Primary credentials, primary model, business configuration, AI ownership and customer messages are unchanged by this rollout.

raw_failures: missing_any:['需求', '協助', '告知', '說明', '備註', '記錄', '記下來']
review.reason: Observed 告訴我們 and 幫您協調 are valid equivalents of the expected 告知/協助. Response answers dietary question, preserves restaurant limitations, and adds no price or sales-pressure question. Original test evidence retained.
review.reply:
有喔～這條桃花9日的團費有包含住宿酒店的早餐。午餐和晚餐沒有包含，因為沿途餐廳選擇多，可以依自己口味和預算安排；機票和小費也不含。
可以的～您先告訴我們不吃辣，用餐時導遊會依沿途餐廳的實際情況幫您協調。西藏有些餐廳調味方式比較固定，能調整到什麼程度，當天會再依餐廳情況確認。

earlier_iteration.issue: Initial adapter removed low reasoning_effort, causing some enabled-thinking requests to hit output limits; a transient timeout then opened backup circuit under forced primary outage. Local conservative test reserve cap was also exhausted. Fixed effort mapping and reran all 18 cases; prior ledger entries were retained.
earlier_iteration.original_lexical_false_positives: Initial keyword check rejected 不用先確定人數才能問 and did not recognize dietary-assistance synonyms. The final run retained one synonym warning, explicitly reviewed rather than silently removed.

validation.availability_probe_scope: Plain-text streaming probes test provider selection and valid completion, not general semantic accuracy. Earlier tiny JSON echo probes received malformed primary JSON and correctly switched to backup; the 18-case business suite separately validates structured tool/decision behavior.

limitations: Live cutover had no new real-customer model run in the brief observation window; installed-code switch tests ran in an isolated process with no Chatwoot writes.
Third-party availability is not guaranteed. All providers failing can still require advisor intervention for a waiting customer; optional outreach defers under the previously deployed protection.
Same-turn provider stickiness remains intentional; next-turn primary-first routing is verified.
security: Credential values excluded from tracked code, reports and test logs. Runtime env remains china2go-owned 0600; backup and candidate credential file restricted.
